meta.name: agent-ui
meta.description: Batteries-included agent component for React/Next.js from ui.inference.sh. One component with runtime, tools, streaming, approvals, and widgets built in. Capabilities: drop-in agent, human-in-the-loop, client-side tools, form filling. Use for: building AI chat interfaces, agentic UIs, SaaS copilots, assistants. Triggers: agent component, agent ui, chat agent, shadcn agent, react agent,  agentic ui, ai assistant ui, copilot ui, inference ui, human in the loop

copy.tagline: 在React/Next.js应用中快速嵌入带运行时和审批的AI助手组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要在React应用中添加带人工审核的AI对话组件
copy.tagline_en: Embed an AI assistant component with runtime and approvals in React/Next.js apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an AI chat component with human-in-the-loop to your React app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成一个可嵌入 React/Next.js 页面的 AI 对话组件，支持流式输出、工具调用、审批流程和表单填写。
howto.when: 当你在 React/Next.js 项目中引入该组件并配置代理 URL 和 API 密钥后，组件会在页面中渲染一个 AI 聊天界面。

say.note: 触发客户端工具扫描并填充表单

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an embeddable AI chat component for React/Next.js pages, supporting streaming, tool calls, approval flows, and form filling.
howto.when_en: When you import the component into a React/Next.js project and configure a proxy URL and API key, the component renders an AI chat interface on the page.
